title: Chapter 292: Two Imperial Calamities
content:
Chapter 292: Two Imperial Calamities

"Fuck, it's so terrifying!"

The young man who was running away looked up at the void, looked behind him again, and immediately started to curse again.

After running for a while, the boy stopped.

The only function of this move is to disperse some of the power in the dark.

It's a little less.

At this time, the catastrophe clouds in the void suddenly began to tremble.

The next moment, a terrifying aura poured down, pointing directly to the boy below.

The Emperor's Tribulation is here!

Seeing this scene, the boy took a deep breath and his expression became firm.

Boom!

With a loud bang, a terrifying thunder catastrophe suddenly fell down and directly struck the young man's heavenly cover.

In an instant, screams rang out.

In the dark, Lu Xue had a rough inference in her heart as she looked at this scene.

The boy in front of him has good qualifications at most.

It is pure luck to be able to reach this point.

It seems that the biggest gain of this trip is that ancient shield.

I don’t know if Qin Feng and the others succeeded.

Just as I was thinking, the second thunder tribulation had already fallen.

Boom!

A more shrill scream sounded from the boy's mouth, looking extremely creepy.

Lu Xue couldn't stand it anymore.

It’s strange to have overcome this tribulation.

Since I have no ability, I dare to overcome the tribulation without preparing.

Could it be that this kid was forced to overcome the tribulation?

As the third thunder tribulation fell.

The clouds of disaster in the void also began to slowly dissipate.

At this time, the boy on the ground had already been covered in bruises and there was no complete area on his body.

"It's done."

The boy spoke hard, but there was no joy on his face.

Buzz —

A pure energy poured into the boy's body.

That is the feedback from heaven and earth after surviving the imperial tribulation.

And this is also the key to becoming an emperor.

But at this moment, several figures suddenly rushed out of the darkness and rushed straight towards the boy.

It's over.

The boy's heart skipped a beat, and then he quickly shouted: "Who saves my life? I'll be a cow and a horse for you!"

However, no one responded to this.

What greeted him was just a ruthless killer move.

Seeing this, the boy smiled miserably and then closed his eyes.

laugh!

Blood gushed, and the temperature suddenly dropped sharply.

"Um?"

The boy suddenly opened his eyes and suddenly realized that he was completely unscathed.

When I looked up, I saw a beautiful figure standing in front of me, blocking the fatal blow.

"you,,"

The boy just started talking about something.

But the woman in front of her rushed out directly.

Immediately afterwards, the powerful dragon power swept the whole audience and the whole scene became completely quiet.

"Nine-clawed Dragon?!"

A scream of exclamation.

Everyone was suddenly a little unbelievable.

"Are you Lu Xue?"

A man in black looked at Lu Xue and said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was slightly stunned. Are she so famous?

But I think so, the name of Nine-Clawed Dragon is really too loud, and Ao Qing is a bit high-profile.

It is normal now that it is well known to the world.

It's just a pity that I still want to be more low-key.

Seeing that Lu Xue didn't say anything, everyone also understood.

"withdraw."

The next moment, several people retreated.

The remaining people looked at the boy in the distance, then looked at Ao Qing, and then left the scene.

"My master, do you see that, we don't need to be low-key."

Ao Qing came up and said proudly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue shook her head, "We will be targeted sooner or later, so it's better to be careful in the future."

Immediately, Lu Xue walked to the boy.

"Thank you for saving your life."

At this time, the young man had absorbed the energy of the heaven and earth, and a stream of the aura of the Immortal Emperor Realm had begun to slowly emerge.

This young man is about to become an emperor.

laugh!

And at this moment, Lu Xue held the Xuanyuan Sword and suddenly crossed the boy's neck.

"Female, hero, why are you?"

The boy's eyes were filled with horror.

I just saved myself and wanted to kill myself again.

What is the operation?

Lu Xue smiled faintly and said, "How much do you have to weigh yourself? Why dare you bring about the imperial disaster?"

Hearing this, the boy's expression did not change, but he immediately returned to normal.

"I have already stepped into the Immortal Emperor realm with half my foot, and I have encountered an opportunity again, so I will naturally become an emperor."

Lu Xue naturally didn't believe this.

As Lu Xue exerted a little force, streams of blood gushed out of the boy's neck.

"Damn it, the heroine, spare me!"

"I said, I said!"

"It's the broken shield, the master of the broken shield cheated me."

Hearing this, Lu Xue frowned, "Which shield tricks you?"

The boy nodded suddenly, "Yes, I just got that shield, and that shield caused me to be the Emperor's Tribulation."

"I suspect that this is the pit set by the owner of the shield."

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue's face changed immediately.

If this is the case, then Qin Feng and the others.

Buzz —

Suddenly, the void trembled in the distance.

A terrifying pressure suddenly came.

Emperor's disaster!

And there are two!

"No, Xiaoqing, let's go!"

Leaving the boy, Lu Xue and Ao Qing hurriedly rushed towards that direction.

At the same time, in the ruins not far from here.

Looking at the fierce gazes around, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo looked a little ugly.

Here, they are the two of them who are the most powerful.

But at this moment, they were a little afraid of acting rashly.

It was just because two terrifying clouds of disaster in the void had locked the two of them tightly.

"This ancient shield is weird!"

Qin Feng said with an ugly expression.

Xiao Luo nodded on the side, "I can see it."

"What should I do now?"

"Oh, I can only wait until Sister Xue comes over to talk about it."

It would be fine if one of them had survived the tribulation.

Another person can also protect his Dharma, but now both of them have overcome the tribulation at the same time.

Of course, this is not the most critical.

The most important thing now is whether the two of them can survive the imperial tribulation alive.

You know, three years ago, the two of them were only in the middle stage of the Immortal Saint Realm.

How long has they just reached the peak of the Immortal Saint Realm?

The emperor's robbery is extremely dangerous.

There are many masters who died in the Immortal World history.

Therefore, after reaching the peak of the Immortal Saint Realm, if you want to safely survive the imperial tribulation, you must accumulate strength.

It can be as short as tens of thousands of years, and it can be as long as millions of years.

Some even had their lives to end, and they were only able to break through to the emperor before their death.

What about the two of them.

Too hasty.

And everyone around was still staring at the two of them.

But when he looked up at the two catastrophe clouds in the void, a trace of solemnity flashed in everyone's eyes.

At the same time, they were also a little confused.

At this time, choose to break through to become an emperor. Are you crazy?

Only a few people noticed something was wrong, looked at the ancient shield in Qin Feng's hand, then withdrew from the competition and left here directly.

"Boss, what should I do now?"

Not far away, a man looked at a man holding a scimitar in front of him and asked.

Hearing this, the man of the scimitar was silent for a moment and said, "Let's talk about it when the fifth and sixth brothers come back."

However, as soon as the words were finished, two figures rushed from afar.

"Boss!"

"Huh? How about the fifth and sixth brothers?"

Looking at the two, the scimitar man asked quickly.

A man looked ugly and said, "That guy broke through to become an emperor."

"What!"
